newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Record 2.44 mln bbls of diesel trades in Singapore.
newsitem.headline: Record 2.44 mln bbls of diesel trades in Singapore.

text.p: A new one-day diesel trading record was made with the sale of 2.44 million barrels in 16 physical cargoes to three traders for lifting in May at lower prices of between $25.70 and $26.50 per barrel, traders said on Thursday.
Traders said the buyers were two related Singapore trading companies and a Japanese trader, who among them have purchased at least 17 million barrels since March 3.
Among the sellers on Thursday were a European major with six cargoes, a Swiss trader with four cargoes, another European major and a regional refiner with a cargo each.
Despite the huge purchases, prices have fallen by between 50 and 80 cents per barrel from Wednesday when two cargoes were traded at $27.00 and $26.50 for May liftings.
The last single record was set on April 11 when the same three traders bougght 1.91 million barrels. Before that the traders purchased 1.35 million barrels on April 8.
